title: Climate scenario explanation
prompt: Create one complete 16:9 documentary image for CAMP CENTURY. Image1 establishes the OWNER-APPROVED DRAWING STYLE ONLY: confident detailed ink and charcoal linework, restrained watercolor, paper tooth, blue-white snow, olive winter clothes, sparse rusty ochre objects. Do not copy its composition or subjects unless requested. Any additional image is FACT reference only. Match the drawing style, not a new design system. Full finished composition, large explanatory drawing, legible short English labels integrated into the scene/paper. An illustrated scientific notebook page with two large conceptual snow/ice sections rather than a fabricated graph: left increasing snowfall adds layers above small dark structural remnants, right a simple melting/percolation illustration shows water entering upper snow. Draw no flowing radioactive river, no numerical depth axis, no invented projections or graph curves. Exact text only: BURIAL; MELTWATER; Different processes; Projections depend on assumptions; A scenario is not an observed spill. Clear ink/blue watercolor explains the distinction visually, not a generic text slide. All base artwork must be CLEAN: NO yellow highlighting, NO underlines, NO marker strokes, NO selection circles, NO loupes, NO glow or animated accents baked into the image; those are added later in DaVinci Resolve. No generic three-line title card, UI, HUD, floating boxes, fake official seals/signatures/stamps, tiny filler text, placeholders, empty panels, decorative noise or burnt parchment. Use 6 percent safe margins. This is authored explanatory artwork, not an original archival record. No invented quantities, dimensions or measurement curves. No other projects or bases. Text only as explicitly specified.
